subject: Fix macOS unit test by wrapping test object symbols (#4281)
reason: The change touches only src/Makefile and src/unit/Makefile: it fixes the macOS unit-test build by wrapping test object symbols, deleting stale static archives before re-creating them, and removing flat-namespace linker flags from the test binary link. No server, command, replication, persistence, or tool code changes, so the shipped valkey-server and tools behave identically; this is a build/CI fix with no runtime behaviour to exercise, and no scenario is needed.
